note: Handy Appliances dryer purchase -> commercial. THE goods-sale anchor for diagnosis_solution: this invoice diagnoses nothing and repairs nothing -- it supplies a Blomberg dryer with delivery, connection, a ducting kit and haul-away of the old unit. An early version of the prompt framed the field around a fault and its repair, and returned '' here on 1 run in 3; the rule that a supply of goods is still summarised was added because of this document, verified 5/5 non-empty afterwards. It is also the positive anchor for warranty (a 1 yr free extension, Jan 17 2026 - Jan 16 2028, plus the manufacturer warranty and its exclusions) and the negative anchor for recommendation, which is asserted '' -- the invoice proposes no further work. Second-order value: a two-page invoice whose SUB TOTAL / PST / GST / TOTAL print only on the continuation page, and one of the few corpus docs with a real pst_amount (82.11). WATCH: the warranty text measured 403 characters on 1 of 3 replicates against a 400-character limit that is enforced in the prompt only -- the prompt has since been tightened to two sentences with no enumerated exclusion list, but this document is the standing overflow probe. || service_address IS asserted: the Ship To block prints 'Noble & Associates Property Management, Tenant: Victor / 6888 Alderbridge Way / Unit 701 / Richmond, BC / V6V 3C3' and the written value correctly drops the company/tenant name line. The four-line block collapsed to one line 9 runs in 10 and kept a break on the 10th; build_write_values now collapses whitespace in the written address, so it is one stable string. || NOT asserted here: payment_due_date -- the invoice prints terms 'CHARG' and no due date, so the write value is the today+30 default and would change with the run date; diagnosis_solution, diagnosis_solution_zh_hant, warranty (free text, reworded across replicates; all verified correct by eye); invoice_description (free text, excluded by standing rule). || C2 2026-08-18: amount_excluding_gst 1255.11 asserted -- derived as 1313.76 - 58.65, stable 14/14. || folio_number ADDED 2026-09-09 with the new folio twins (commercial-narrative-v20). It is a critical field on property tax notices only (field_policy.PROPERTYTAX_DELTA), and is asserted on every sidecar -- the value on a tax notice, "" everywhere else -- so a regression that starts populating it on ordinary invoices is caught. || account_number ASSERTION REMOVED 2026-09-13 (user authorised). The page prints the number beside 'Bill To:' and 'Ship To:' (6042641001), but CU does not always return it: on the second live re-roll of 2026-09-13 (analyzer b5b984bc1a88) r0 came back with both account_number twins at confidence 0.836 and NO value, so the pipeline wrote '' (r1 wrote 'Account No: 6042641001' from the extract at 0.873; r2 from the extract at 0.604 and the generate at 0.415 agreeing). Over every cached read of this PDF the written value was blank on 9 of 110: 0 of 92 before 2026-09-08, 8 of 9 on analyzer db29961e7034 (2026-09-08), 1 of 9 on b5b984bc1a88. account_number is critical only in the municipal bucket (field_policy.MUNICIPAL_DELTA), so on this commercial bill a blank read still routes HAPPY_PATH_CANDIDATE and writes the record with no account number -- removing this assertion stops the corpus reporting that, not the thing itself.
